name: Beasts and dinosaurs
description: Beasts and Dinosaurs in green and red: big trampling creatures, +1/+1 counters, ramp to cast them early and fights to clear the way.

cards.name: Ruhgra, Cinder-Crested Matriarch
cards.rule_text:
Trample
Whenever another creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
cards.flavor_text: The ground shakes twice: once when she roars, once when she lands.

cards.name: Ossa Hornwild, Herd-Mother
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. If it's a Beast or Dinosaur, put two +1/+1 counters on it instead.
Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have trample.

cards.name: Thunderhoof Alpha
cards.rule_text:
Trample
Other Beasts and Dinosaurs you control get +1/+1 and have trample.
cards.flavor_text: Where it runs, the herd follows.

cards.name: Mossgrub Hatchling
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {R} or {G}.
Whenever another Beast or Dinosaur you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Cragtooth Raptor
cards.rule_text:
Trample
Enrage — Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, it deals 2 damage to target opponent.

cards.name: Briarcoat Cub
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target Beast or Dinosaur you control.
cards.flavor_text: Small today. Not small for long.

cards.name: Thornback Wanderer
cards.rule_text:
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Scorchmane Brawler
cards.rule_text:
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.

cards.name: Ashquake Charger
cards.rule_text:
Trample, haste
Enrage — Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.flavor_text: Hurting it only makes it bigger, and angrier.

cards.name: Stonefield Grazer
cards.rule_text:
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Cinderfang Behemoth
cards.rule_text:
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, it deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, other Dinosaurs you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Valleyhorn Titanosaur
cards.rule_text:
Trample, ward {2}
When CARDNAME enters, other creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.
cards.flavor_text: Mountains have been named after smaller things.

cards.name: Horn Meets Claw
cards.rule_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature fights target creature you don't control.

cards.name: Follow the Stampede
cards.rule_text: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: Where the herd has walked, the path is easy.

cards.name: Bellow of the Burning Crag
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you control a Dinosaur, CARDNAME also deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller.

cards.name: Earthshudder Charge
cards.rule_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Then creatures you control gain trample and haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Nesting Grounds of Ages
cards.rule_text:
Whenever a Beast or Dinosaur you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more creatures with power 4 or greater, draw a card.

cards.name: Ambered Fossil Idol
cards.rule_text: {T}: Add {R} or {G}. If that mana is spent on a Beast or Dinosaur spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Smouldering Fern Hollow
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped.
{T}: Add {R} or {G}.
{3}{R}{G}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target Beast or Dinosaur you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
